🏗️ Solution Architecture (Offline Web PWA, Native SwiftUI iOS App & Google Cloud Mode)

This unofficial tool is engineered across two dedicated offline-first form factors—an Analytical Offline Web PWA (dist/) and a Modern Native Universal SwiftUI iOS/iPadOS App (ios/GoogleCloudExplorer)—backed by a once-a-day local cache or serverless Google Cloud backend (~$0.30/month).

🛡️ Quota & Rate-Limit Protection Architecture

  • Daily 24-Hour Cache TTL (data/cache/gcp_catalog.json): All user searches, region lookups, AI model checks, SLA calculations, pricing comparisons, and CLI queries are served 100% from local static HTML and cached JSON. Upstream Google Cloud endpoints are only queried once every 24 hours (or when explicitly forced via --force).
  • Token-Bucket Rate Limiting: Outbound requests during the daily harvest are paced through a thread-safe token-bucket rate limiter (default 15 requests/sec across 8 bounded worker threads) to prevent burst quota exhaustion on discovery.googleapis.com.
  • Exponential Backoff with Full Jitter & Retry-After Parsing: Any HTTP 429 Too Many Requests, 403 Rate Limit Exceeded, or 5xx response automatically honors the server's Retry-After header or backs off using random.uniform(0.5 * base * 2^attempt, base * 2^attempt) up to 5 attempts.
  • Per-API Disk Checkpointing & Offline Sync: Every Discovery REST spec is atomically written to disk, while the Web PWA Service Worker (sw.js) and Native iOS app bundle (mobile_catalog.json) provide full Airplane-Mode offline capability.
